children: Saba Capital Management, L.P., a 10% owner, reported purchasing 255,199 shares of Highland Opportunities & Income Fund common stock indirectly through funds and accounts it manages on November 17, 2026, at $5.01 per share. The total purchase amount was $1,278,547. Following the transaction, Saba Capital Management, L.P. indirectly held 6,232,543 shares through those funds and accounts. Boaz R. Weinstein is the managing member of Saba Capital Management GP, LLC, the general partner of Saba Capital Management, L.P.
